# Motion Graphics Skill Pack

> Give your AI agent a motion director

Official repository: https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/motion-graphics-skills
Website: https://immamdouhaboammar.github.io/motion-graphics-skills/
Version: 1.1.0

Motion Graphics Skill Pack is a set of 20 skills for Claude Code and Codex covering creative direction, reference analysis, brand intake, motion briefs, motion graphics, video editing, programmatic video, Arabic and RTL motion, publishing, and rendered-film review.

The master motion-director skill owns concept, narrative, art direction, typography, composition, choreography, production routing and creative QA.

For new code-driven motion projects, HyperFrames is the preferred production infrastructure for deterministic timelines, reusable registry blocks, diagnostics, preview, audio relationships, variants and final rendering. Existing stable runtimes should be preserved when rebuilding would add no value.

## Skill groups

Direct:
- motion-director
- mix-and-match
- brand-intake
- motion-brief-writer

Edit:
- jump-cut-pacing
- speaker-cutout
- video-spotlight
- paper-cut-motion

Build:
- launch-video
- apple-launch-film
- vox-explainer
- animated-chart
- milestone-reveal
- motion-effects
- title-sequence-3d
- model-showdown

Publish:
- newsletter-promo
- loop-cover
- reel-export

Review:
- video-review-loop
